exposure: Number of contacts with telemedicine intervention
cohort: 1,574 pregnant women considered at risk and enrolled in a telemedicine educational intervention.
finding: Older age, sedentary lifestyle, and overweight/obesity were associated with cesarean delivery, while younger age and more frequent contact with the telemedicine intervention were associated with increased emergency room visits during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Older age, sedentary lifestyle, and overweight/obesity were associated with cesarean delivery.
